Aircraft.name: Car Industrial - Hoister

Label.State.designText: ! WARNING Trained Operators and Mechanics Only Read craft instructions located in the Pause menu at the top left. Failure to follow craft instructions can cause serious mayhem! KNOW THE EQUIPMENT •ALWAYS use 3 points of contact when getting on and off the truck. •DO NOT operate or repair truck unless trained and authorized. •USE attachments for intended purpose only. LOOK WHERE YOU ARE GOING •IF YOU CAN'T SEE, DON'T GO! •TRAVEL in reverse if load blocks forward vision. •MAKE SURE tailswing area is clear before turning. •SOUND horn at intersections or wherever vision is blocked. If horn is not functioning, make a "beep beep" sound with your mouth. KNOW YOUR LOADS •HANDLE only stable loads within weight limits. •DO NOT handle loose loads higher than load backrest. USE COMMON SENSE •NEVER transport people on any part of the truck. •OBEY traffic rules. Yield right-of-way to pedestrians. •BE in complete control at all times, unless you're doing something really fun, in which case YOLO so send it. •ALLOW NO ONE under or near lift mechanism of load. •OPERATE truck only from operator's seat. •DO NOT use truck to lift people, unless they ask politely. •BEFORE DISMOUNTING, lower forks and apply brake. PROTECT YOURSELF •AVOID bumps, holes, loose or slippery materials, etc. •AVOID sudden movements. Operate controls smoothly. •NEVER turn on or angle across an incline. •TRAVEL on inclines with load uphill or unloaded with mast downhill. •SLOW DOWN before turning. •FAILURE to follow these instructions can cause the truck to tip over!
